purpose: Prevent repeated reuse of failed methods under new packet names and keep Step1, Step2, data, and evaluation evidence roles separate.

versions.method: direct or effectively joint 16-action prediction with high-capacity HGB-style modeling and heterogeneous internal/external resource stores
reusable: historical baselines only when exactly replayable on the current stack
forbidden: reuse old scores as current evidence
train direct 16-class PM on small grouped data
switch resource stores between training and external evaluation

versions.method: component applicability or opportunity proxies trained from constructed labels
forbidden: call proxy applicability a learned quality-risk-cost policy

versions.method: four component effect heads on transport-repaired but noisy single-response labels
forbidden: lower pass thresholds after seeing results
append small packets until a head passes

versions.method: source-matched prompts plus generator use/ignore declarations, reasons, and copied evidence spans
root_causes: generator trace writing was confused with resource function
past evidence promoted to current fact

versions.method: typed component plans, component-specific exact spans, fail-closed shared bundle, eligible-only 32-item Step2 gate
root_causes: exact-span bookkeeping reintroduced a known 8B interface burden
base and fallback generation hallucinated unsupported history or claims
forbidden: treat all machine fallbacks as memory non-use
treat human functional use as safety

versions.method: backend-bound typed resource compiler, response-only generator, deterministic provenance and safety guards, four low-capacity Step1 net-value heads
versions.implementation_budget: one implementation plus one untouched Step2 confirmation; no iterative small packets

versions.method: existing outcome-blind opportunity layer plus four requested-action ITT value heads under one frozen deterministic typed adapter and response-only generator
versions.invalid_itt_only: mechanical assignment, binding, missing-outcome, or frozen-identity failure
versions.formal_training_allowed: after complete primary and independent-overlap annotation exports only
versions.statistical_unit: 256 state-candidate units nested in 128 two-unit counterfactual groups
